reference_checks.check: When the seller clicks 'Mark as Sold' (and confirms if prompted) on an active 'Available' listing page, the listing status updates to 'Sold' on the listing page.
When the seller marks an active 'Available' listing as 'Sold' from the listing page, an option to undo/relist becomes available.
When a buyer or guest searches for a listing marked as 'Sold' using its exact title and category filters, the sold listing does not appear anywhere in the search results.
After the seller marks a listing as 'Sold', a buyer who had an existing chat thread about it sees a 'Sold' badge on the listing preview in the chat inbox/list.
After the seller marks a listing as 'Sold', a buyer who had an existing chat thread about it sees a 'Sold' badge on the listing header/preview inside the chat thread.
When the seller clicks 'Undo Sold' / 'Mark as Available' on a 'Sold' listing page, the listing reverts to 'Available' status.
After the seller undoes 'Sold' status on a listing, the listing reappears in buyer search results.
After the seller undoes 'Sold' status on a listing, the 'Sold' badge is removed from existing buyer chats.

checklist_items.item: Seller can mark their own listing as sold from the listing page.
A sold listing no longer appears in search results.
Buyers with an existing chat about the listing see a 'Sold' badge.
Seller can undo marking a listing as sold to revert it to available.
A non-owner cannot mark someone else's listing as sold.
After undo, the listing reappears in search results.
After undo, the 'Sold' badge disappears from existing buyer chats.
